== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-hearmebabyholdtogether-PC-Errata-2018-E-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Hear Me Baby, Hold Together (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same words as the previous version. This is a full card image again (348 × 488 pixels), with the white italic “E” in the black lower border.

The 2017 slip and the same area of the 2018 E card, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
